text: Visitors have noted issues with the timed entry system, including confusion about when they can enter and long lines during peak times. Crowding inside the library, especially in narrow exhibit areas, has made the experience uncomfortable for some guests. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, feeling it detracts from the historical content. Accessibility information and customer service via phone were also mentioned as areas needing improvement. Payment options have caused frustration, particularly for international visitors.

windows.7: Visitors noted confusion about entry times and recommended clearer communication about when guests can arrive relative to their scheduled tickets. Some found the use of AI in exhibits excessive and inconsistent with the spirit of the library’s subject. Accessibility information was difficult to obtain by phone, leading to frustration for those without internet access. Positive comments focused on the interactive exhibits and architecture, but concerns about crowding and parking were also mentioned. Overall, the average rating remains high, but these issues suggest areas for improvement in visitor information and exhibit design.
